scope: retained-running ADSP, v12 host-private SMEM, retained calibrated MI2S/COPP route

implemented.glink: v1, apr_audio_svc, 8 receive intents, reuse negotiation, fragments and backpressure
implemented.apr: v2, strict service/domain/port/token matching; published timeout quarantines epoch
implemented.pcm: 48kHz signed16 stereo interleaved, shared host ring to explicit reserved DSP window
implemented.adm: matrix mapping to a retained COPP
implemented.position: GET_SESSIONTIME_V3 rendering time; host APR-reply observation timestamp

smem.protocol: QcomSMEMRequest; Snapshot then read-only Lookup; caller retains and opens service
smem.mapping: borrow the sole owner's mapping; no separate ADSP alias or hardware-lock owner
smem.glink_partition: AP 0 / ADSP 2 private partition; no global fallback

remaining: ADSP PAS cold firmware load/authentication and resources
AFE/MI2S cold initialization and board clock/pinctrl producer
native Core Audio/media-service runtime and physical playback validation
